"""
PostgreSQL database schema for user and assessment data.
"""

-- Users Table
CREATE TABLE users (
    user_id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    username VARCHAR(50) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    email VARCHAR(100) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    password_hash VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    role VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('student', 'teacher', 'admin')),
    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

-- Assessments Table
CREATE TABLE assessments (
    assessment_id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    description TEXT,
    created_by INT REFERENCES users(user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    due_date TIMESTAMP
);

-- Submissions Table
CREATE TABLE submissions (
    submission_id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    assessment_id INT REFERENCES assessments(assessment_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    submitted_by INT REFERENCES users(user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    submission_text TEXT,
    submission_file VARCHAR(255), -- File path or URL
    submitted_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

-- Grades Table
CREATE TABLE grades (
    grade_id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    submission_id INT REFERENCES submissions(submission_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    score FLOAT CHECK (score BETWEEN 0 AND 100),
    feedback TEXT,
    graded_by INT REFERENCES users(user_id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    graded_at TIMESTAMP
);
